quests:title: Today's Quest
quests:subtitle: Five things. About ten minutes.
quests:progress__note: Overall quest progress. Both are whole numbers, always 0–5.
quests:reward.task__note: XP for one completed slot. {xp} is a whole number.
quests:reward.bonus__note: The completion bonus, shown before it is earned.
quests:slot.locate__note: Task title. The user taps a country. Max 24 characters.
quests:slot.discover__note: Task title — content the user has never seen. Max 24 characters.
quests:slot.perform__note: Task title for the performance goal. Max 24 characters.
quests:goal.streak_keeper: Any lesson at all — that is the whole task
quests:task.count__note: Progress within one task, like 3 / 4. Tabular numerals.
quests:task.done__note: Shown on a completed task. Max 8 characters.
quests:task.label: {title}, {progress} of {target}
quests:task.label__note: Accessibility label grouping one task row.
quests:complete.title: All five. Nice work.
quests:complete.body: Your next quest arrives at midnight.
quests:empty.title: Your quest is being built
quests:empty.body: Finish a lesson and today's five will be ready.
quests:tab.daily__note: First half of the segmented control at the top of the Quests screen — today's quest. Max 12 characters.
quests:tab.achievements__note: Second half of the segmented control on the Quests screen; opens the achievement set. Max 14 characters.
quests:resets__note: Line under the task list, and on the quest cover page, saying when today’s quest is replaced. Both numbers are whole; hours can be 0. A whole sentence rather than a wrapper around a formatted duration — see useDayCountdown.
quests:intro.title: Daily Quest
quests:intro.title__note: Title of the sheet that opens today's quest. The same words as the Quests tab's own heading, because it is the same quest. Max 16 characters.
quests:intro.headline: {count, plural, one {# challenge today} other {# challenges today}}
quests:intro.headline__note: Headline on the quest cover page. {count} is the number of CHALLENGES (tasks) in today's quest, five today and generated, so it must be a plural. Not questions: the tasks ask for more answers than that, and the cover said 'Answer 5 questions' above a list of fourteen answers and a lesson. Same word as Home's 'Five challenges at your own pace'.
quests:intro.body: Finish them all to earn the bonus.
quests:intro.body__note: One line under the headline saying what the quest is for. Max 2 sentences.
quests:intro.start__note: Primary button on the quest cover page. Verb first. Max 3 words.
quests:done.title: Quest complete
quests:done.title__note: Headline on the screen shown once the daily quest's last task lands. Warm, not loud — no exclamation mark, and never a superlative about the person. Max 20 characters.
quests:done.body: That's today's five. Come back tomorrow for the next set.
quests:done.body__note: One line under the headline. States what was finished and what happens next. Never implies the user must return — an invitation, not an obligation.
quests:done.reward.xp__note: Accessibility label for the XP tile on the quest-complete screen. This is the completion bonus, already awarded by the server. {amount} is a whole number.
quests:done.reward.coins__note: Accessibility label for the coin tile on the quest-complete screen. {amount} is a whole number.
quests:done.streak: {count, plural, one {# day in a row} other {# days in a row}}
quests:done.streak__note: The streak, stated on the quest-complete screen as something earned rather than as a scoreboard. Hidden at zero.
quests:done.milestone__note: Shown ONLY on a day that hits a streak milestone (7, 30, 100 or 365 days), which is the only day a streak pays anything. {amount} is a whole number.
quests:done.cta__note: The button that leaves the quest-complete screen. Deliberately not 'Claim' — the reward is already granted, and a button that claims what you have been given is a lie about who did what. Max 8 characters.
quests:adventure.continue__note: Invitation or real saved-currency progress. Next unlock is the least expensive unowned title. No new reward is granted.
quests:activity.new.body: {count, plural, one {Answer # new fact correctly.} other {Answer # new facts correctly.}}
quests:activity.new.body__note: Task goal. Count is the target, not the remaining number. Facts must be first seen in the credited lesson.
quests:activity.review.body: {count, plural, one {Recall # fact ready for review.} other {Recall # facts ready for review.}}
quests:activity.review.body__note: Task goal. Correct answers to distinct facts due for review count. Count is the target, not the remainder.
quests:activity.practice.body: {count, plural, one {Answer # different fact correctly.} other {Answer # different facts correctly.}}
quests:activity.practice.body__note: Task goal. Count is the target. Each fact counts toward one task per day, regardless of lesson type.
quests:task.detailLabel__note: Screen-reader label for a task with a goal description; announce the goal as well as the current count.
quests:activity.new__note: Daily task credited by distinct correct facts from any lesson. Repeating one fact never counts twice; progress is server verified.
quests:activity.review__note: Daily task credited by distinct correct facts from any lesson. Repeating one fact never counts twice; progress is server verified.
quests:activity.practice__note: Numbered practice task; round is its position in today's quest. Distinguishes repeated practice tasks without implying a required question type.
